safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention neck stiffness or lack thereof.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness is part of screening for meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage red flags. Omitting this negative finding can reduce confidence in the safety assessment and may prompt unnecessary escalation or repeat evaluation.

Omission may lead to less optimal pain management but is unlikely to directly cause serious harm by itself.
